source_line: Source: American Farm Bureau Federation, 41st annual survey, Nov. 2026
caption:
Thanksgiving dinner for 10 runs $58.63 this year — about $5.86 a plate.

That's up 6% from $55.18 last year and the first rise since 2022, after three straight years of falling prices (American Farm Bureau Federation, 41st annual survey, prices checked early November). The 16-lb frozen turkey leads it at $23.68, up 10%. Cranberries are up about 9%, dinner rolls 7%, sweet potatoes 5%.

It's still roughly 8% below the 2022 record of $64.05, and stores are discounting hard — some shoppers found turkey as low as 69 cents a pound.

My take: this is a shop-the-deals year, not a skip-the-bird year — the loss-leader turkey is the one thing worth chasing a sale on.
